# Steam — cart-ambush completion dialog loop

- Original source: [Steam discussion](https://steamcommunity.com/app/46560/discussions/0/802345327968471760/)
- Participants: GrandDuke and Wanoo
- Language / date: English; displayed opening April 19, year omitted
- Access: Full thread retrieved directly (opening post and 1 reply)
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Retrieved: 2026-09-09
- Archived copy: lookup failed (archive.org rate limit); not checked

GrandDuke reports being unable to complete a side robbery after collecting money during a cart ambush. A popup returns after acknowledging it, apparently before the player can use another confirmation control on the right.

The report does not identify the exact ambush variant, executable version, save file, or input configuration. It is an unresolved reproduction lead, not a diagnosed scripting or interface bug.

## Discussion

**GrandDuke — 19 April, year not shown:** “I can't finish one side robbery mission where [I] need to grab money during cart ambush. A small pop-up appears when I get money and after I press OK I need to press the same button on the right side again. Before I do that, the same pop-up window appears and I cannot pass this loop. Anyone know a solution?”

**Wanoo — 24 April, year not shown:** “Try asking on Discord. However, it would be helpful to share a solution if you find one.”

No fix was supplied.
